Appearance:
MR HARDIK SONI, APP for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 3 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 3 MR SHAKEEL A QURESHI(1077) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 SHIVANG A THACKER(7424) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER 1.
This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
2. Mr. Hardik Soni, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, who is present in person before this Lok Adalat and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in R/CR.A/1589/2013 ORDER nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

sentences.text: 1 4. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.

The respondent No. 3 is directed to pay a sum of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only) and the respondents No. 1 and 2 are directed to pay Rs. 3,000/-(Rupees Three Thousand only) each (in all,
the respondent No.3 to deposit Rs. 5,000/- and the respondents No. 1 and 2 to deposit Rs. 6,000/-)
towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties, in lieu thereof.
Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

5. Learned advocate Mr. Shivang A. Thacker appearing on behalf of the respondent no.2 is not present today and learned advocate Mr. D. K. Modi for the respondent no.3 requested this court to pass necessary order and assures the court on behalf of the respondent no.2 that whatever the orders which the court may pass shall also be followed by the respondent no.2.

6. However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other R/CR.A/1589/2013 ORDER proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.
